purpose: Representative real-microphone scenarios combining FSM evidence with STT, barge-in, and latency telemetry.

callerScript: Perdón, he dicho Javier, no Gabriel.
scenarios.timing: Normal turns after the verification request.
requirements: Correction is not treated as a new case objection

callerScript: Javier Pérez, responsable de la empresa.
scenarios.timing: Pause long enough to produce two STT segments.
requirements: First fragment does not unlock disclosure
Second complete turn may verify identity

scenarios.timing: Interrupt the agent mid-sentence after disclosure.
requirements: FSM reaches ended in the same turn
No persuasion follows the termination request

callerScript: Use a cough or table tap with no words.

requirements: Noise does not create an FSM transition

requirements: Interpreter and response complete without fallback
LLM TTFT and TTS TTFB meet the production profile
